conditions.resources: Frozen public documentation and standard registry integration; no Logic2b CLI/MCP tools.
Same documentation and fixture plus released Logic2b CLI/MCP.
Same fixture and CLI/MCP plus implemented project context, behavior contracts, review and change plans. Unavailable until these implementations exist.

tasks.acceptance: List, filter and edit customer data; independently assert persisted changes.
Exercise slow data, failed load, retry and denied operation without losing input.
Add a filter while preserving custom copy, a custom column and token override.
Apply an upstream component update with local modifications; surface conflicts without silent overwrites.
Evaluate similar interactions in a different domain with long content; keep fixture outside authoring examples.

controls: Pin host, model/version or explicit alias, capability profile, fixture hash, registry/tool/schema versions and time/token budgets within a cohort.
Pre-register seed and randomized schedule; use a fresh opaque workspace id for every attempt.
Retain incomplete, failed and timed-out attempts in the denominator. Report assisted rescues separately.
Independent evaluator captures actual build and browser evidence. Blind human design review where practical.
No paid model runs or participant outreach without applicable authorization.
Hash sanitized artifacts after removing credentials, personal data and private paths; retain provenance privately.
Synthetic cases are excluded from comparative reports; protocol v1 and its leaderboard are immutable.
Record interventions for each condition; hashes alone do not establish truth or evaluator independence.
Within-Logic2b ablations require a separately registered condition/protocol extension. Do not pool cross-registry runs.
